scene_rooftop_intro.title: Act I • Rooftop Conclave (The Gathering & Warning)
scene_rooftop_intro.description: Five close friends gather on a rooftop terrace in the evening. As they smoke and laugh, tension rises as one delivers a warning about local boss intimidation.

scene_living_room_attack.title: Act II • Living Room Confrontation & Patriarch Shock
scene_living_room_attack.description: Aftermath of a home intrusion. Overturned green plastic chairs, broken household items. The elderly patriarch collapses on the floor pleading for non-violence while the protagonist comforts him.

scene_living_room_dialogue.title: Act II • Close-Up Dialogues & Retaliation Pact
scene_living_room_dialogue.description: Tense close-ups and singles of the friends in the living room debating whether to call the police or hunt down the perpetrators themselves.

scene_roadside_discovery.title: Act III • Old Airport Road Assault Aftermath
scene_roadside_discovery.location: Old Airport Road & AP Aviation Academy
scene_roadside_discovery.description: Roadside shrubs and gravel outside the flight academy. Discovery of a fallen comrade's arm with sacred thread and the wooden club left behind by assailants.

scene_street_pursuit.title: Act III • Armed Sprint & Climax Pursuit
scene_street_pursuit.description: High kinetic sprint. Two friends carrying sticks race down the tarmac and roadside in pursuit of the getaway vehicle / assailants.
